title: Orchestrator trial leads L106 and L108-L111: sprint speed, in-round modifiers, reserve ammunition, recoil bounds

L106.question: Is there a per-weapon sprint-speed operand, or a Support-class exemption from a sprint-speed penalty, in the 1.4.3.0 weapon assets?
sourceFacts: Sprint speed is soldier-level: GRX_Glacier_Soldier registry records DefaultStandSprintTopSpeedMultiplier (value 1.857, bounds 1 and 3) and FastSprintTopSpeedMultiplier (2.05, bounds 1 and 3). Raw f32 checks: offset 23188 bytes 2db2ed3f and offset 17868 bytes 33330340, file sha256 9b44340483d9af272ef5f0cbda5934ad9a30ff1f055fd3fddc60fc4943e822cc (L106/l106-rawchecks.json). The value/bound field order (Field_42c8b257 / Field_c06d0cbb / Field_3ff76ddb) is presumed, not proven.
The only consumer found is the dependency list of Gameplay/Soldier/Traversal/SimEx_RootLayerLogic (entries 78 and 79); no weapon file references either record (grep of the Common XML tree).
MSA_Hip_Weapons = [1]. SSA_Weapons resolves to SprintSettings_T00..T11, which store two recovery times (0.05-0.40 s), i.e. the sprint recovery the site already models, not a speed.

The Assault trait's sprint entry is a Class_03db7a68 draw step (+1, sprint recovery); WPM_SupportTrait carries WME_ADSTime_Anim_P10 and WME_ADSTime_FOV_P10 only. The four Ability_*Trait assets differ only in GUIDs and hashes (no operand).

Import-set scan over 63 WB/GS/Ability roots: the only imports shared by at least 8 of 10 LMGs and at most 2 other weapons are WPM_SupportTrait (WB, 10/0), GID_ADSTime_Trait_P10 (GS, 10/0), a compact vertical grip pair and U_ATT_RK2_B25U. Known-answer control: the Support trait and its ADS GID are found 10/0.
L106.inference: The Support 'no sprint speed penalty' text has no per-weapon source operand; any penalty and exemption are probably native or animation-driven. This is an inference from absence in the scanned assets, not a native-behavior claim.
unresolved: A scalar-leaf scan (LMG-constant leaves in WB/GS/Ability) returned 0 but its control failed (the Support trait binds by reference, not scalar), so that scan is not reported as a negative; only the import-set scan carries a passing control.
Whether the two soldier multipliers depend on the equipped weapon inside SimEx_RootLayerLogic (native graph, not decoded).
L106.siteImpact: None. Sprint speed is uniform in source; there is no per-weapon comparison stat to add. Closed with the search list above.
L106.workers: none (answered directly by the orchestrator in six queries)

L108.question: What do GRM_MountedPlusVertical/Horizontal contain and bind, compared with the neutral base GRM_Mounted* and the GRM_BipodDeployed assets?
sourceFacts: Each aim block (Zoomed Field_6b84de87, Unzoomed Field_7b609515) adds RecoilAmountMultiplierExponent +3 and RecoilDirectionVariationMultiplierExponent -2 in both GRM_MountedPlusVertical and GRM_MountedPlusHorizontal; base GRM_MountedVertical/Horizontal are 0/0; GRM_BipodDeployed_BTM_P50 is +10/-4; GRM_BipodDeployed_Bolt_BTM_P50 is +30/-5. 24 operands raw-checked by the worker; the orchestrator re-read MountedPlusVertical amount +3 (offset 616, bytes 03000000, sha256 c7ac6b92a6705c6fcb41803677775a903c28731ada677f43445609572abefea2).
Root booleans differ only in the state condition: Vertical assets Field_93dd77b9 true, Horizontal Field_b0057325 true, bipod assets Field_b574fa40 true (values only; meanings unknown).

All 63 site GS roots bind both MountedPlus assets under selector b9e5e8e5-1d51-45ec-99d2-2b77b0144dfc (U_Ability_MountedPlus) with entry index 1003 (Vertical) and 1002 (Horizontal): one distinct tuple, no exceptions (decoder DB by the orchestrator; the worker raw-checked selector and index on 9 weapons, one per site class plus M16A3, 72 reads). Base Mounted selectors are weapon-specific.

WM_MountedPlusHorizontal/Vertical (WB, all 63) also carry three modifier blocks of unnamed camera/visual vectors (0.67, 0.33, 0.5/0.4/0.7) that were not decoded further (out of scope; the fields are the L18/L98 unnamed family).
L108.conditionalSiteArithmetic: Site convention amount x amountMult^(exp+tier), variation x dirVarMult^(exp+tier) over data/weapons.json (ADS block): MountedPlus +3/-2 gives amount x0.800-0.855 and variation x1.161-1.223 across 63 weapons; BipodDeployed +10/-4 gives amount x0.475-0.594 and variation x1.348-1.495; Bolt bipod +30/-5 gives amount x0.107-0.209 and variation x1.452-1.653. Conditional; additive composition and activation are assumed.
unresolved: Native production of the mounted state and of U_Ability_MountedPlus (an Ability_MountedPlus asset exists but no weapon imports it); composition with bipod; what the Vertical/Horizontal flags select.
Whether MountedPlus is a class/progression unlock or default (the name suggests an in-round progression reward).
L108.siteImpact: None applied. Enhancement proposal for operator review (state toggle); the operator decided on 13 Sep to document mounted/bipod recoil without model changes, before the MountedPlus operands were known.

L109.question: What do WM_WeaponSwap and WM_Killshot contain and which site weapons import them?
sourceFacts: WM_WeaponSwap (Class_897c99a7 -> one Class_4aac041b draw step): Field_9540bd8e = +1 (raw i32 at offset 216 = 01000000), the same class as the Assault deploy step; selector 7727fe65-6ddd-4d10-aeb8-e2d1e59c9054 has no owning asset in the captured collection. 60 of 63 site WBs import it; absent on CZ3A1, DB-12 and Vz. 61.

WM_Killshot (Class_897c99a7 -> one Class_e218a1ca): a single unnamed boolean Field_8d6d2bc1 = true (raw bool at offset 216 = 01), every other leaf neutral; selector c9ac1d21-bc55-48ae-a825-90f3b15d6817 is U_Ability_Killshot (Ability_Killshot exists). Imported by the 6 site Sniper Rifles only (interdictor, l115, m2010esr, miniscout, psr, sv98). Class_e218a1ca occurs in no other asset.
Soldier registry KillshotSuppressionResistance 0.25 (bounds 0.1/0.5) is a separate soldier-level record; no link to WM_Killshot was established.
unresolved: What the Killshot boolean enables (unnamed; no text found); the WeaponSwap selector's owner and activation.
L109.siteImpact: None. WeaponSwap is a uniform deploy step (+1, one tier faster) on 60 weapons, so it does not change weapon comparisons except for the three exclusions; Killshot has no numeric operand.

L110.question: What MagazineCapacity, NumberOfMagazines and InitialAmmo are serialized on the 63 weapon bodies and in the 125 magazine WPM assets, and how does capacity relate to the site magazine values?
sourceFacts: Control passed: HK433 31/7/-1, DP12 16/6/-1, M60E6 100/2/-1 (raw); site m433 mag = 31. 63 WB rows all raw-checked (189 checks); 125 magazine WPMs (62 Extended, 48 Compact, 15 ExtendedFast; census difference 0), 24 raw-checked (72 checks). InitialAmmo is -1 on every row.
Base WB MagazineCapacity equals data/weapons.json mag on all 63 weapons (for example 31 for the 30-round default). Site WEAPON_MAG choice mag values are menu nominal capacities.

Joining site magazine choices to source through the weapon Ability object (branch guid), its referenced action object and the selector GUID listed in the WPM's Field_819acc98 resolves 182 WPM-linked rows and leaves 107 choices on the base WB. Source capacity minus site nominal: +1 on 171 of 182 WPM rows and on 94 of 107 base rows; 0 on 11 WPM rows and 12 base rows, all large-capacity belt LMG magazines (45-200 rounds) and the two revolvers (M44 6, M357 Trait 8); +2 on the DB-12 (16 vs 14). Every non-LMG class is +1 on every row.

NumberOfMagazines varies with the magazine choice. Examples (capacity x count = product): M4A1 20 Rnd 21x10=210, 36 Rnd 37x6=222, 40 Rnd 41x6=246; base HK433 31x7=217; M60E6 base 100x2; AK-205 36 Rnd 37x7, 45 Rnd 46x6. Base counts range from 2 (belts) to 15 (LMR27).
L110.inference: Source capacity is the nominal capacity plus a chambered round for closed-bolt weapons, and equals nominal for belt-fed and revolver weapons. This matches the pilot pairs recorded in L37 (M433 20 Fast 20/21, DB-12 14/16, M60 50 Rnd 50/50) and turns them into a rule over all choices. Whether the game loads N+1 on a tactical reload only, and whether NumberOfMagazines counts the loaded magazine, are runtime questions.
unresolved: The worker's join by file-name token was inadequate (WPM files are named by caliber family); the orchestrator join above replaces it (L110/orch_join.py, orch_join.json).
107 choices resolve to the base WB, not to a magazine WPM; two RPK-74M/RPKM choices match both weapons' WPMs, which differ in NumberOfMagazines (8 vs 7).
Meaning of NumberOfMagazines and of the +1; meaning of InitialAmmo -1.
L110.siteImpact: None applied. Proposals for operator review: (1) show carried rounds per magazine choice (capacity x NumberOfMagazines) as a loadout stat; (2) treat the source +1 as a chambered round for tactical reloads on closed-bolt weapons. The operator's in-game knowledge (HUD reserve count for one default weapon) can confirm the count semantics without a capture.

L111.question: What are the current per-weapon values of the named GS recoil bound fields (VerticalRecoilMin/Max/Increase, HorizontalRecoilLeft/Right, MaxVerticalRecoil) in both aim states, and does the cap matter for the site's recoil path?
sourceFacts: 882 values (63 weapons x 2 registry-named blocks x 7 fields). Control passed: HK433 RecoilAmount raw 0.6694999933242798 (5a642b3f at offset 1084) in both blocks = site 0.6695. All 126 MaxVerticalRecoil values and 558 modifier operands raw-checked by the worker; the orchestrator re-read P18 (GS_M18) MaxVerticalRecoil 90 at offset 992 (bytes 0000b442, sha256 8b39c067c13e149c1f2186e7d615aa5740f9dcbda106e416fc17aef656b4cc2d).
MaxVerticalRecoil is 20 in both blocks on 60 weapons and 90 on ES57, GGH22 and P18. Zoomed and Unzoomed values differ for 6 weapons.

VerticalRecoilMin/Max are archetype-like constants: Min/Max pairs 0.578/0.578, 0.42/0.42, 0.35/0.35, 0.43/0.43, 0/0, and DMR/sniper/sidearm Min 0.6 with Max 0 and Increase 0.6; HorizontalRecoilLeft takes five values (0.2-0.6) and Right five (-0.1 to -0.6). They do not track RecoilAmount (M39 EMR 1.45 and SVK-8.6 2.5 share Min 0.6, Max 0).
Only one modifier binding touches these fields: GRM_SVCh_Marksman_SP on SVK-8.6.
L111.siteCheck: Running sim/core.js genRecoilPts over every weapon for a full magazine (seed 0, ADS and hip) gives a maximum vertical displacement of 8.6 degrees (DB-12), then 8.29 (TR-7), 6.75 (VCR-2), 6.54 (M4A1), 6.08 (M433), 6.06 (M121 A2); no weapon reaches 20.
L111.inference: UsePolarRecoil is true on all 63 weapons (L33), so the min/max and left/right bounds probably belong to a non-polar recoil path and do not enter the site's polar model. The 20 degree cap is not reached by the site's own path on any weapon. Both are inferences.
unresolved: Native use of the bounds and of MaxVerticalRecoil; the site path is an assumed equation.
The XML overlay cache was absent, so the binding scan used decoder-DB import edges.
L111.siteImpact: None. No calculation defect found; the cap is not a constraint on the site's recoil path.
